acceptanceCriteria: A file-change for a newly created untracked path produces no console.warn: either Core returns a structured expected code that the OpenCode adapter records at info, or the adapter filters untracked paths, with a test under TestHostAdapterJavaScriptHosts.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 OpenCode 2 port (adapter 0.3.0) during the rc.2 adapter audit. In a live opencode2 2.0.18 turn, a write that created stubfile.txt sent file-change {"paths":["stubfile.txt"]}; the binary exits 2 with "impact paths are not tracked at revision ...", which reaches the plugin as corvint-command-failed and is logged as a console.warn fault. Creating files is routine, so this is a false fault on most turns. Decision 0379 already treats unsupported-impact-path-suffix and unsupported-impact-repository as expected; an untracked path needs its own structured code, or the adapter should drop untracked paths before calling file-change. Probably pre-dates the port (OpenCode 1 file.edited had the same input); not verified.

title: OpenCode warns on every newly created file because file-change refuses untracked paths
